text:
maria: Hey team — quick async check. I'm onboarding nova-14b weights. I uploaded safetensors to s3://inbound/models/nova14b/v1/ but conversion CI failed. Anyone have a minute to glance at packaging config?

sam: Which CI error? Can you paste the short log?

maria: Build-convert shows: "unexpected tensor shape for key 'lm_head.weight' — expected (512, 512) got (2048, 2048)". Thinking TP layout mismatch (TP=2 vs TP=8). Also saw tokenizer vocab mismatch in some samples.

kevin: That shape error is classic TP mismatch. Did you run convert with the same --tp that the original export used?

maria: Command I ran:
```
convert-checkpoint --input s3://inbound/models/nova14b/v1 --format safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --out /tmp/nova14b
```

sam: If upstream shards were generated with TP=8 and you used --tp 2 you'll get those shapes. Try --tp 8.

ashley: Also double-check fp16 vs bf16. We recently had a model uploaded as bf16 but labeled fp16 — conversion passed but produced NaNs downstream. CI now tries to validate dtype in safetensors header but older uploads slip through.

ci-bot: build-convert #427 failed — shape mismatch detected. Re-run conversion with corrected TP/dtype and attach logs.

maria: Re-running now with --tp 8 and trying bf16 to see. Also ran a tokenizer quick check: 
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(len(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').get_vocab()))"
```
Result: 50280, but model config expects 50257.

kevin: Vocab delta of 23 usually means extra special tokens were added downstream. Two options: 1) patch model config.vocab_size to 50280, or 2) trim tokenizer (not ideal). If any token ids exceed embedding matrix, you must expand embeddings. Check emb shape after conversion.

sam: Quick review ping @kevin @ashley — after conversion I'll open a PR updating packaging.yml and adding a conversion unit test asserting shard shapes and dtype metadata.

ashley: Please add a preflight script that checks: 1) dtype header in safetensors, 2) each shard's weight shapes vs expected shapes (TP-aware), 3) tokenizer vocab vs config.vocab_size, 4) presence of expected kv_cache-friendly names. I can paste our snippet from recent onboarding. :+1:

maria: Sounds good. I'll attach conversion logs and the command output in the PR. One operational Q: where should final artifact live? For this customer we want it in a private bucket, not public staging.

kevin: Put final artifacts in s3://redwood-dedicated/onboarded/nova14b/v1/, set ACL private and tag owner=eng-ml; add metadata `deployment: dedicated` and `onboarded_by:maria`.

maria: Noted. ETA EOD PST. Thanks all.

sam: If you hit anything weird, drop the exact convert log here and I'll triage. :eyes:
